---
title: "The full journey — 17 modules, zero to frontier"
toc: false
---

::: {.lx-plain}

Larnix is one continuous path: start knowing nothing, finish having pretrained
and shipped your own small language model. Here is the whole map. **M0–M3 are
live today** — about 50 chapters, every one runnable in your browser at ₹0 —
and the rest unlock as the curriculum grows, in the order below.

Tiers: 🟢 Beginner · 🟡 Intermediate · 🔴 Advanced. Compute: **browser** =
runs on this page, nothing to install; **colab** = free cloud GPU notebooks;
**gpu** = one optional, low-cost rented-GPU capstone (a free smaller-model
path is included).

| # | Module | Tier | Compute | You build |
|---|--------|------|---------|-----------|
| **M0** | [How to use this school / What is AI?](modules/00-orientation/index.qmd) · **live** | 🟢 | browser | Run your first pretrained model; confirm the ₹0 path |
| **M1** | [Python for AI](modules/01-python/index.qmd) · **live** | 🟢 | browser | A data-cleaning notebook (auto-graded) |
| **M2** | [Math You Actually Need](modules/02-math/index.qmd) · **live** | 🟢→🟡 | browser | The math of one neuron — forward + backward, by hand |
| **M3** | [Data & Tooling](modules/03-data/index.qmd) · **live** | 🟢→🟡 | browser | A full EDA on a dataset you've never seen |
| M4 | Classical Machine Learning | 🟡 | browser | An end-to-end tabular predictor + model card |
| M5 | Deep Learning Foundations | 🟡 | colab | A neural net from scratch, then in PyTorch |
| M6 | Specialized DL: Vision & Sequences | 🟡→🔴 | colab | An image classifier + a char-level sequence model |
| M7 | NLP & the Transformer | 🔴 | colab | A small GPT, from scratch |
| M8 | Large Language Models: adapt & evaluate | 🔴 | colab | A LoRA fine-tune with rigorous evals |
| M9 | Reinforcement Learning & Reasoning Models | 🔴 | colab | A model post-trained to reason measurably better |
| M10 | Generative AI: diffusion, multimodal, audio | 🔴 | colab | A text-to-image mini-app |
| M11 | **Build Your Own LLM end-to-end** | 🔴 | gpu | Data → tokenizer → pretrain → post-train → quantize → serve |
| M12 | AI Engineering: RAG, Agents & MCP | 🟡→🔴 | colab + browser | A production-style RAG + tool-using agent, with eval |
| M13 | Production AI: MLOps & LLMOps | 🔴 | colab + browser | A deployed, monitored, cost-instrumented AI service |
| M14 | Responsible AI: safety, security, ethics | 🟡→🔴 | browser | Red-team & harden your own app |
| M15 | Applied ML electives | 🟡→🔴 | colab + browser | One elective (forecasting / recsys / speech / …) shipped |
| M16 | Career & job-readiness | 🟢→🔴 | browser | A portfolio of deployed projects + mock-interview loop |

Every module ends in a graded capstone, and a learner can complete **M0–M10 for
₹0** — browser now, free Colab/Kaggle tiers later, free local models (Ollama)
where a lesson touches an LLM API. The one optional spend in the whole
curriculum is a few hundred rupees of by-the-second GPU rental for the M11
pretraining capstone, and even that ships a smaller-model free path.

Builders and contributors can see how this maps to build phases in the
[public roadmap](https://github.com/venkathub/larnix/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md).

Ready? [Train your first model ▸](modules/00-orientation/ch01-train-your-first-model.qmd){.btn-clay}

:::
